svg.title: Everton Santos — back-end developer
svg.desc: Pixel art title screen: the name Everton Santos in large letters, next to the character over a yellow circle. Back-end developer: I write the rules nobody sees — payroll math, permissions, audit trails — and the tests that prove they work.
